what: the reach of the package's exact softmax, counted at the call. `verb` is the taped verb (exact forward AND exact Jacobian); `raw` is the module-wide `ttnn.softmax`, which is the only thing that reaches `autograd.triangle_attention._scores` in the forward and in the chunked backward's recompute. A zero in `raw` means the pair track ran on the card.

installed_from_corrected.why: the context manager never calls install(). The two paths stopped being equivalent when ownership was added, so the old stamp named a route this arm did not take. Re-emitted rather than left: a recorded input is part of the artifact's identity.
